text:
incident-bot: ALERT: ArkCom (vpc: arkcom-prod-eu-west) p99 latency spike detected on dedicated pool arkcom-eu-west-pool — 5m p99=2.8s (> SLO 1.2s). Errors low, increased tail latency. Pager: @alex_oncall :rotating_light:
alex_oncall: Acked. joining. any immediate customer-visible impact?
maya_support: Support dashboards show ~18% request failures? Actually 0.6% errors. Mostly high tail latency and slow streaming responses. Customers reporting timeouts from app logs.
sam_runtime: Looking at runtime metrics — batch size growth, KV cache miss rate up 4x, sequence lengths spiked (user test jobs). Could be large prompt flood from one tenant.
julia_cs: I'm on the line with ArkCom's infra lead, they say some internal sweep ran at 14:05 UTC hitting long prompts. They want mitigation — keep them posted.
ryan_infra: Pool utilization at 92% on all nodes. No machine OOMs. Autoscaler didn't trigger because pool is reserved and min nodes reached.
priya_sre: Running quick tenant isolation runbook: `runbook/tenant-noise-isolation` — will confirm tenant id if noisy.
alex_oncall: Can we isolate without evicting? prefer soft-shielding first (rate-limit)
sam_runtime: Agreed. On runtime we can apply per-tenant rate-limiter at the router for arkcom-prod -> set token limit to 0.5rps for the noisy tenant. Command:
```
# set tenant limit
redwood-cli tenant update-rate --tenant arkcom:tenant-47 --rate 0.5
```
I'll run after triage.
priya_sre: Which tenant id?
maya_support: From logs the top peak is tenant-47 (internal test harness).
julia_cs: ArkCom confirms tenant-47 is their CI job running a long generation test. They can pause but need 10-15 minutes.
alex_oncall: ok proceed with soft rate-limit and warm-failover. Sam, Ryan coordinate on routing fallback?
sam_runtime: Plan: 1) apply soft rate-limit to tenant-47 2) enable fallback routing for ArkCom to quantized model variant (latency-optimized) for non-critical routes 3) warm spare nodes if required. I can flip routing policy to prefer ark-q4f on path /generate?customer=arkcom
ryan_infra: I can provision 2 warm spares in eu-west (estimated 4m to spin). Kicking off now: `infractl pool scale arkcom-eu-west-pool +2 --warm`
priya_sre: I'll watch SLO dashboard and set paging thresholds to 10m p99. If we see >3m still, escalate to SEV.
alex_oncall: Maya, can you draft an immediate customer message for ArkCom? Keep brief, state mitigation and ETA.
maya_support: Drafted: "ArkCom team — we're investigating elevated latency in your EU-WEST dedicated pool. We've applied temporary limits to an internal test tenant and are routing non-critical traffic to a latency-optimized model. Estimated 15 minutes to stabilize. Will update in 5." Want me to send?
julia_cs: Send now and mention we'll follow up with post-incident timeline.
priya_sre: Rate-limit applied to tenant-47. Confirming reduced request rate to ~0.6rps.
sam_runtime: Routing policy updated: ArkCom traffic is now 60% -> ark-q4f fallback for non-stream endpoints. Command used: `routerctl set-policy arkcom --prefer ark-q4f --match "route!=stream" --weight 60`
alex_oncall: Any immediate improvement on p99?
priya_sre: p99 dropping from 2.8s -> 1.4s within 40s. p95 stable at 0.8s. Still above SLO but trending down.
ryan_infra: Warm spares active in 3m. Node join logs: `node-ark-eu-12 joined pool` 
priya_sre: After warm nodes join p99 -> 0.9s, now under SLO.
alex_oncall: Nice. Is ArkCom still seeing app timeouts? Maya?
maya_support: ArkCom confirmed timeouts stopped after our message and the routing change. They paused tenant-47 job.
julia_cs: ArkCom asks for a short postmortem and whether we recommend increasing dedicated pool capacity or tenant-level quotas.
sam_runtime: Recommendations: 1) set per-tenant burst quotas for heavy prompt jobs, 2) add automated soft-shields for detected high sequence-length patterns, 3) consider +2 reserved nodes for peak window (they have predictable daily CI at 14:00 UTC).
alex_oncall: Who owns follow-up? Sam to write technical mitigation doc, CS to draft customer-facing postmortem, Infra to propose capacity change.
sam_runtime: I'll open a follow-up GitHub issue and link the metrics, kernel selection logs, and router policy change.
priya_sre: Scheduling a 30m follow-up post-incident triage at 14:45 UTC. I'll create calendar invite and include ArkCom if they want.
maya_support: Sent customer update and will attach timeline when available.
julia_cs: ArkCom appreciate quick action. They're okay with proposed follow-up.
alex_oncall: Handing off to Priya for monitoring until triage. I'm available if it re-escalates. Good job team. :thumbsup:
priya_sre: Handoff acked. Closing war room and will post incident summary to #postmortems after triage.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) — severity: SEV2 -> pending triage. Links: metrics-dashboard/arkcom/7732104567, runbook/tenant-noise-isolation
